name: mosaic-still-life
description: Mosaic-tile + painterly hybrid editorial illustration. Tessellated/pointillist mosaic surfaces (grass, sky, sand, walls, floors) anchor the scene, with crisp painterly still-life objects rendered ON TOP. Always features a still-life centerpiece on a table, an animal companion at the heart of the scene, and at least one patterned textile peeking through. Cozy, nostalgic, bucolic mood. Trigger when user says /mosaic-still-life, asks for a "mosaic illustration", "mosaic-tile editorial illustration", "tessellated still life", or briefs with a palette + scene + animal in this style.
